name: Namcot 163

components.role: Namcot 163 ASIC with PRG/PPU banking, CIRAM routing, RAM protection, CPU-cycle IRQ and sound-RAM ports
Chip-internal 128-byte wavetable RAM, eight time-multiplexed voices and single serial DAC

notes: Mapper 19 models the Namcot 163 package. The multiplexed expansion-audio DAC remains cartridge-local until a generic analog cartridge-connector path is available.
